subject: Renewal: plan to move Gravitas subscription to AWS Marketplace / co-sell coordination
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@gravitas.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: plan to move Gravitas subscription to AWS Marketplace / co-sell coordination

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the time last week. Gravitas's annual renewal for our Enterprise plan is coming up on 2026-10-22 and you mentioned procurement is pushing to buy via AWS Marketplace for chargeback reasons. We're happy to support that.

Quick summary of what we typically need to move a direct seat/license/commitment to Marketplace:
- a short mutual action plan that ties the renewal effective date to the new Marketplace subscription date
- confirmation on pricing parity (list price vs marketplace SKU) and any discount expectations
- marketplace SKU(s) and desired term length (12/24 months)
- contact for your procurement/team who will sign in the marketplace UI or accept the marketplace invoice
- co-sell registration details so we can register the opportunity with AWS for potential incentives

If helpful, I can schedule a 30-minute call with our Partner/Marketplace lead to walk through the flow and timeline. Attached is a one-page checklist we usually send to customers (Gravitas_Procurement_Checklist.pdf).

Proposed next step: can you confirm (1) procurement contact, (2) whether you need a marketplace-only invoice cadence, and (3) whether you expect a discount vs the direct renewal?

Thanks —
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
rachel.kim@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0143

Attachment: Gravitas_Procurement_Checklist.pdf

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@gravitas.ai>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Morris <elena.morris@gravitas.ai>, procurement@gravitas.ai
Date: Mon, 14 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal: plan to move Gravitas subscription to AWS Marketplace / co-sell coordination

Hi Rachel — thanks, appreciate the checklist.

Short answers:
- Procurement lead is Elena Morris (cc'd). Procurement prefers marketplace purchases for all cloud-related software to simplify chargebacks and approvals.
- We are open to parity pricing; however procurement will evaluate the total cost of ownership (they asked if Redwood can offer a marketplace-friendly discount or credits on the first renewal term).
- For co-sell, our field seller Sean will coordinate directly with the AWS rep; I'll intro him once we have the dates locked.

I'll attach our internal procurement questionnaire — it has a couple of items that will help you populate the marketplace listing fields (billing contact, invoice requirements, tax info). Let's tentatively plan on the marketplace subscription going live on 2026-10-22 so it lines up with our internal renewal cycle.

Samir
Samir Patel
VP Product, Gravitas Systems
samir.patel@gravitas.ai

Attachment: Gravitas_Procurement_Questions.pdf

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 08:25:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Renewal: plan to move Gravitas subscription to AWS Marketplace / co-sell coordination

Thanks for the heads-up, Rachel. Narrowing this into a playbook for the team — here's what we should do and who owns each item: 

1) Confirm commercial terms with Gravitas (Rachel) — parity pricing vs direct. If they request a marketplace-first discount, we need an approval note from Sales Leadership.
2) Generate marketplace SKU(s) and pricing rows (Sales Ops: Neha) — use Marketplace_SKU_template.csv for the format.
3) Create a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) linking the direct renewal cutoff to marketplace activation date (Rachel + Samir). I can draft MAP language.
4) Partner/co-sell registration (Diego) — we need the AWS rep contact and to submit the co-sell opportunity before the subscription goes live to be eligible for credits.
5) Legal/Finance: if there are invoice preferences or tax questions, loop Legal (contracts) and Finance.

Neha — can you confirm typical lead time to create SKUs and entitlement sync with AWS? We usually need ~10 business days for the SKU + entitlement pipeline once commercial terms are locked.

I'll mark this as high priority and will escalate approvals if Gravitas is asking for any first-term discounts.

- Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Director, GTM Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachment: Marketplace_SKU_template.csv

From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@gravitas.ai>
Cc: AWS Partner Sales <aws-co-sell@amazon.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 10:40:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal: plan to move Gravitas subscription to AWS Marketplace / co-sell coordination

Folks — adding a couple operational notes from the partner side: 

- Co-sell registration: we need the AWS EP contact (field rep) to register the opportunity. Samir, if you can share Sean's contact or loop him in that will speed the process.
- Partner portal: I'll submit the co-sell opportunity once we have the HubSpot deal ID (please confirm HubSpot link), and we'll attach the MAP there.
- Entitlement sync: the SKU needs to be created in the marketplace and then the entitlement mapping pushed to our entitlement service. Typical turnaround is 7-12 business days after SKU creation, but if we coordinate early with the AWS partner team we can expedite.

Shared links: HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/3891234 
Partner registration guide: https://partner-network.amazon.com/co-sell/registration/AMY-EP-123

I'll prepare the co-sell checklist and circle back with the partner ops owner.

Diego Fernandez
Partner Lead, Redwood Inference
diego.fernandez@redwood.com

Attachment: Marketplace_SKU_template.csv

From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir.patel@gravitas.ai>, Elena Morris <elena.morris@gravitas.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 10:00:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Renewal: plan to move Gravitas subscription to AWS Marketplace / co-sell coordination

Samir / Elena — thanks for confirming the procurement preference and timeline. Proposed plan and asks (short):

1) We will draft a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that ties the effective renewal date (2026-10-22) to the Marketplace subscription activation. Marissa will draft the MAP and I will share a PDF by EOD Wed 2026-09-22.
2) Neha will provision the Marketplace SKU once Gravitas confirms desired term and parity pricing. Please confirm term (12 or 24 months) by Friday 2026-09-24.
3) Diego will lead co-sell registration with the AWS EP once we have the HubSpot deal and contact for Sean (field seller). Samir — can you loop Sean into this thread?

I attached a short MAP template / mutual_action_plan (Mutual_Action_Plan_Gravitas_v1.xlsx) to make approvals quicker. I recommend a quick 30-minute call next week (options: Tue 9/28 10:00-10:30 PT or Wed 9/29 11:00-11:30 PT) to finalize dates and handoffs.

If Gravitas confirms 12 months and price parity, we should be able to cut over to Marketplace on 2026-10-22 with enough runway for SKU creation and entitlement sync. If a discount is requested, we'll need a brief internal approval and a signed amendment.

Thanks all — looking forward to wrapping this up.

Rachel
Rachel Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachment: Mutual_Action_Plan_Gravitas_v1.xlsx
